title: La Navidad en las montañas
author: Ignacio Manuel Altamirano
note: La Navidad en las montañas (Altamirano, 1871; school edition by E. A. Hill and M. J. Lombard, 1917): a Mexican novella in eleven chapters, I-XI, after the dedication. The English footnotes ([Footnote n: ...]) and their markers, illustrations and markup are dropped; the English introduction, notes and vocabulary are left out (the text ends at VOCABULARY).
